experiment_template.research_question: Does removing rejected non-evidence from the delivery ledger permit a complete and passing H37 experiment?
stop_conditions: No Round 23 identity is resumed or rerun.
No task, threshold, scorer, order, context/output/total-token cap, or semantic state policy changes.

records.falsifier: A rejected read creates delivery credit, a successful malformed read is accepted, any shared integrity failure continues, the full denominator is not accounted, scheduled span gain is below +0.05, file or valid completion degrades, unknown usage appears, or state increases model tokens.
records.mechanism: Parse the tool result first. If it is ok:false, record no delivered observation and do not parse its malformed request arguments. Successful read results retain exhaustive argument, receipt, source, and provenance validation. Keep the H37 state treatment and all benchmark variables unchanged.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Ignoring malformed arguments only when their read result was explicitly rejected prevents non-evidence from poisoning export, allowing the unchanged eight-path one-handle state experiment to complete its full denominator and meet every fixed GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench gate.

dataset_refs: same exposed eight-task cohort; prior round identities remain immutable historical evidence
experiment_template.research_question: Does broader path diversity preserve useful recovery better than two handles across only four paths?
stop_conditions: Every Round 23 identity runs once; failures remain in the denominator.
No task, threshold, scorer, context/output/total-token cap or branch-order change after freeze.

records.falsifier: Any projected handle lacks a matching receipt, a path appears twice, more than eight paths appear, ordering is nondeterministic, control receives state, scheduled span gain is below +0.05, file F1 or valid completion degrades, unknown model usage appears, or state increases cumulative model tokens.
records.mechanism: At each dispatched recycle generation, group delivered evidence by source path, retain the eight most recently observed paths and only the newest distinct handle for each path, restore chronological handle order, and label every item as observed rather than relevant. Keep objective, tools, context limits, 96K token cap, terminal validation, and pairing unchanged.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A cumulative path-diverse evidence projection with at most one newest receipt-bound handle for each of eight newest paths preserves more investigation breadth than the Round 22 four-path policy while eliminating duplicate-path frequency, improving GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench quality and completion within cumulative model input plus output tokens.

experiment_template.research_question: Does continuity require both discovery anchors and recent working paths?

records.falsifier: The mixed horizon increases stale anchoring, loses recent working evidence, or misses any fixed quality, validity, integrity, or token gate.
records.mechanism: Reserve bounded slots for earliest distinct paths and fill the remainder with newest distinct paths, one receipt-bound handle per path.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A mixed-horizon projection retaining both early and recent observed paths prevents discovery loss better than a newest-only projection.
